### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>godbus/dbus (github.com/godbus/dbus/v5)</summary>

### [`v5.2.3`](https://redirect.github.com/godbus/dbus/releases/tag/v5.2.3)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/godbus/dbus/compare/v5.2.2...v5.2.3)

#### What's Changed

- README: update by [@​kolyshkin](https://redirect.github.com/kolyshkin) in [#​431](https://redirect.github.com/godbus/dbus/pull/431)
- Switch from reflect.Ptr to reflect.Pointer by [@​kolyshkin](https://redirect.github.com/kolyshkin) in [#​430](https://redirect.github.com/godbus/dbus/pull/430)
- mediakeys.go example: Fix error handling. by [@​smu-ggl](https://redirect.github.com/smu-ggl) in [#​433](https://redirect.github.com/godbus/dbus/pull/433)
- Test/fix CI issues by [@​guelfey](https://redirect.github.com/guelfey) in [#​439](https://redirect.github.com/godbus/dbus/pull/439)
- Misc CI bumps; replace cirrus freebsd with GHA; add all-done job by [@​kolyshkin](https://redirect.github.com/kolyshkin) in [#​420](https://redirect.github.com/godbus/dbus/pull/420)
- make GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm go build ./... work by [@​eliasnaur](https://redirect.github.com/eliasnaur) in [#​435](https://redirect.github.com/godbus/dbus/pull/435)
- Do not swallow non-error panics in Encode/Decode by [@​kolyshkin](https://redirect.github.com/kolyshkin) in [#​438](https://redirect.github.com/godbus/dbus/pull/438)
- Fix panic in DecodeMessageWithFDs on read error by [@​kolyshkin](https://redirect.github.com/kolyshkin) in [#​437](https://redirect.github.com/godbus/dbus/pull/437)
- Do not embed reflect.Value into exportedMethod by [@​kolyshkin](https://redirect.github.com/kolyshkin) in [#​436](https://redirect.github.com/godbus/dbus/pull/436)
- Add godbus_no_tcp build tag to disable tcp transports by [@​kolyshkin](https://redirect.github.com/kolyshkin) in [#​444](https://redirect.github.com/godbus/dbus/pull/444)
- CI: bump golangci-lint to 2.14 by [@​guelfey](https://redirect.github.com/guelfey) in [#​447](https://redirect.github.com/godbus/dbus/pull/447)
- Do not trust lengths from the input when allocating by [@​kolyshkin](https://redirect.github.com/kolyshkin) in [#​442](https://redirect.github.com/godbus/dbus/pull/442)
- conn: support /run and /var/run default addresses by [@​twilly](https://redirect.github.com/twilly) in [#​424](https://redirect.github.com/godbus/dbus/pull/424)

#### New Contributors

- [@​smu-ggl](https://redirect.github.com/smu-ggl) made their first contribution in [#​433](https://redirect.github.com/godbus/dbus/pull/433)
- [@​eliasnaur](https://redirect.github.com/eliasnaur) made their first contribution in [#​435](https://redirect.github.com/godbus/dbus/pull/435)
